answer_text: To transfer CMA admin access when the current admin’s MFA device is no longer available, reset the MFA for that admin first. In CMA go to Account > Administrators, select the admin, and choose Reset MFA; after that admin signs in again and is prompted to add MFA with a new authenticator (scanning the QR code with their own device). Then ensure your replacement has the appropriate RBAC role so they have admin privileges (RBAC defines which admins can view/edit which CMA features).
